turn.content: The records settle it. The PO is for 32 units at 89,200. Two goods receipts of 16 each exist: GR-2026-0044A (2026-10-15) and GR-2026-0044B (2026-10-28). The earlier invoice SI-26-00358 (2026-10-18) has the same total of 1,584,192, which is exactly 16 × 89,200 × 1.11 — i.e., it billed the first 16 units. This invoice, dated 2026-10-29 (one day after GR-2026-0044B), bills the second 16 units. Total invoiced 32 units = total received 32 units, with a goods receipt for this delivery.
